title: Carina's voice
question: Which of these is Carina?

media.caption: How to read this: six designed voices, a to f; e is the lowest and f the brightest. Each card plays her saying "Yeah, IT support. I'm the contractor, it's my first day." Above the cards, for each voice: the reference it was designed with, another of Eric's day-1 lines as hers, "ここ. Right by the fountain." (his day-2 line, with ここ said in Japanese and spliced in, as the game does) and the word clip おはようございます. All are at -20 LUFS. How they were made: each is a Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign voice made from a short description and reading the same English reference text, then cloned with Qwen3-TTS Base, with her Japanese made from the timbre only. Eric's voice, eric-2, was made the same way, so hers would work in the game the way his does. This first clip is Eric's reference, for comparison.
Eric (eric-2, in the game now): "Yeah, IT support..."
Eric (eric-2, in the game now): "Sea on both sides..."
Eric (eric-2, in the game now): "ここ. Right by the fountain."
Eric (eric-2, in the game now): おはようございます

options.label: a. Tired and quiet
options.note: Matches carina.json ("tired woman in her thirties, quiet and polite"). Reference pitch about 184 Hz. It's low enough that her lines would need the pitch check for drift (under 190 Hz, the same check Mio has). Design prompt: "A woman in her thirties, quiet and polite, a little tired. Soft medium-low voice, gentle and reserved, unhurried, slightly weary at the end of a long day but kind. Neutral, standard English with no regional or foreign accent." Takes: seeds 404, 505 and 606 for each line, picked with Whisper (the text it heard, P(ja) over 0.9 for Japanese, then the pitch closest to the reference): en1 606, en2 404, ここ 606 with English 505, word 404.
